2010.simple: The mobile company’s sign-in desk. It checks your SIM card and sets up your phone’s tunnel, then lets the parcels go past it.
2010.technical: The SGSN: attach and authentication (with the HLR), mobility and the PDP context. With Direct Tunnel (3GPP Rel-7) it sets up the GTP-U tunnel between RNC and GGSN and stays out of the user plane.
